context: Asuka lectures on willpower and reason.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: philosophy lecture; vocabulary (極めて/ゆえ/果たし/意志/ないし) in natural home.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 人の意志は、極めて強い力です。
lines.en: Human will is an extremely strong force.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured philosophical clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 意志ゆえに、人は変われるんですか?
lines.en: Because of will, can people change?
lines.style: attentive adult student voice, soft warm earnest engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、強い意志ゆえに、夢を果たします。
lines.en: Yes, by strong will, they fulfill dreams.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured philosophical clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 役割を、果たすのは難しいですね。
lines.style: thoughtful adult student voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 極めて困難でも、意志が支えます。
lines.en: Even extremely difficult, will sustains you.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured philosophical clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 一人、ないし二人で、支え合うんですね。
lines.en: One or two people support each other.
lines.style: curious adult student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 仲間がいるゆえに、果たせるのです。
lines.en: Because we have companions, we can fulfill it.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured philosophical clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 意志を、強く持ちたいです。
lines.en: I want to hold a strong will.
lines.style: moved adult student voice, soft warm realization throughout
